text:
Riley (AE): Quick sync  customer on POC wants to sign today. They sent back an order form with DPA redlines and an ask for HSM-backed keys + a 99.9% SLA for the POC window. Can legal & finance confirm acceptability and signing flow?
Priya (Legal): Thanks. Main chgs: specify AES-256 at rest, faster subprocessor disclosure (7 days notice), and restrict processing purpose to feature evaluation. SLA request looks aggressive for a short Dedicated POC. Need SRE/infra feasibility and credit calc.
Noah (Finance): They'll pay via PO. They asked for two invoices (POC vs future committed capacity) and Net45. Net45 needs FP&A approval; for now mark as pending. Also need PO number on the prod invoice and billing@redwood.com cc.
Tess (Infra): HSM + VPC peering for a POC points to a Private/Dedicated deploy. Setup estimate 48-72hrs after network details and key import. If they insist on HSM import into our HSM, we need an infra ticket and KB signoff.
Viv (Security): Please attach SOC2 and the latest pentest report. Also confirm encryption-in-transit (TLS1.2+) and whether any customer data is PHI. If PHI, we need HIPAA addendum.
Riley (AE): Customer replied: "no PHI, evaluation only; prefer parallel signing to speed up." They gave PO: PO-2026-9984 but want Net45.
Priya (Legal): Parallel signing ok. I'll prepare a 1-page SLA addendum that narrows the SLA scope to the Dedicated inference pool used for the POC and includes a credits formula capped at X% of monthly fee (will define). I'll accept most DPA redlines except subprocessor timing  that remains 30 days, propose 14-day disclosure instead.
Noah (Finance): If Legal adds split-invoice language and PO on invoices, Finance can accept Net45 pending an FP&A quick sign-off. Please put billing contact for customer and Redwood.
Tess (Infra): Need customer CIDR for peering, KMS key format for import, and expected qps/avg seq length. If they want pre-shared keys in HSM, we need formal key import window.
Riley (AE): Copying the snippet I'll include in the order form: 
```
Sign order flow:
- procurement@cust.com (procurement) => sign step 1
- accounting@cust.com (finance) => sign step 1 (parallel)
- ceo@cust.com (exec) => sign step 2 or parallel if exec available
Fallback: email-approval with audit log if exec delay >48h, countersign within 5 business days.
PO: PO-2026-9984
Invoice split: POC invoice (one-time) + Reserved capacity invoice (monthly)
```
Priya (Legal): Good. Addendum will reference order form by date and include AES-256 at-rest clause and subprocessor disclosure timeline (14 days). I'll mark SLA credits & key import responsibilities as open items.
DocuSign Bot: Envelope created (env_89c3f). Status: sent to procurement and accounting.
Viv (Security): I'll upload SOC2 link and pen-test summary to the envelope. Also confirm TLS1.2+ and AES-256 at rest in a short statement for them to keep.
Noah (Finance): Once envelope is back, route invoices to billing@redwood.com. I'll attempt FP&A approval for Net45 right away.
Tess (Infra): Once we have CIDR & key format I'll open the private-deploy ticket and tag infra-oncall for key import scheduling. Expect 2 business days to complete.
Riley (AE): Thanks all. Action items: Priya draft addendum, Tess open infra ticket when CIDR arrives, Viv upload security docs, Noah chase FP&A, I'll update envelope with the redlined DPA PDF. React with :thumbsup: when done.
Priya (Legal): Will send addendum in ~1hr.
Noah (Finance): Chasing FP&A now.
Tess (Infra): Ready when CIDR arrives.
Riley (AE): Envelope status shows accounting signed. Proc still pending. Will update when exec signs or fallback kicks in. :rocket:
